ValidationRule.description: The field 'Follow-up Owner' is required when Follow-up Department is selected. The epic for reference #1008. The rule updated for CAC Executive Escalations record type. For ref, check user story #27296 on Gitlab.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(RecordType_Name__c ="Global Service Case",RecordType_Name__c ="CAC Executive Escalations"), OR((ISPICKVAL(GSC_Follow_up_Department__c, "Care")), (ISPICKVAL(GSC_Follow_up_Department__c, "Online System Support")), (ISPICKVAL(GSC_Follow_up_Department__c, "A2C")) ), ISPICKVAL(GSC_Follow_up_Owner__c, "" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: 'Follow-up Owner' is required when Follow-up Department is selected.
